purpose: Verify a real externally acquired capability can be hash-pinned, bound, selected by the deterministic capability planner, executed, and effect-verified without a model controller.
goal: Extract the known text layer from a synthetic PDF using the verified bound PDF capability.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python canonical/tests/test_bound_capabilities.py
python canonical/tests/test_capability_planner.py
python canonical/tests/test_astra_runtime_model_independence.py
mkdir -p canonical/astra_runtime/tmp
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
out=Path("canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BOUND_PDF_TEXT_TEST.pdf")
stream=b"BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (PROJECT BRAIN BOUND PDF CAPABILITY VERIFIED) Tj ET"
objects=[
 b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
 b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
 b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 4 0 R >>",
 b"<< /Length "+str(len(stream)).encode()+b" >>\nstream\n"+stream+b"\nendstream",
 b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"
]
pdf=bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
offsets=[0]
for i,obj in enumerate(objects,1):
    offsets.append(len(pdf))
    pdf.extend(f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode())
    pdf.extend(obj)
    pdf.extend(b"\nendobj\n")
xref=len(pdf)
pdf.extend(f"xref\n0 {len(objects)+1}\n".encode())
pdf.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
for off in offsets[1:]:
    pdf.extend(f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
pdf.extend(f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects)+1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n".encode())
out.write_bytes(pdf)
print("SYNTHETIC_PDF_BYTES",len(pdf))
PY

expect.value: PROJECT BRAIN BOUND PDF CAPABILITY VERIFIED
